entries.answer:
**Claude Opus 5 (max)**  
- Context: 1,000,000 input / 128,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: ARC-AGI-3 (30.2%, next best 7.8%); SWE-bench Verified 96.0%[1]

**Claude Fable 5**  
- Context: 1,000,000 input / 128,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: CursorBench v3.2 (70.5%); GDPVal-AA v2 (1741 Elo)[2]

**GPT-5.6 Sol (max)**  
- Context: 1,050,000 input / 128,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: MRCR v2 eight-needle at 256K–512K (91.5%); Terminal-Bench 2.1 (88.8% at max, 91.9% at ultra)[3][4]

**Grok 4.6 (xhigh)**  
- Context: 500,000 tokens (no separate output cap published)  
- #1 benchmark: Terminal-Bench 2.1 (88.39% per xAI eval); AA Intelligence Index tied at 61[5][2]

**Kimi K3 (max)**  
- Context: 1,000,000 tokens  
- #1 benchmark: Frontend Code Arena #1 (1,679 Elo); SWE Marathon #1 (42.0%); BrowseComp #1 (91.2%); Program Bench #1 (77.8%)[6]

**GLM-5.3 (max)**  
- Context: 1,000,000 input / 128,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: CyberGym 84.5% (leading published score)[7]

**Qwen3.8 Max**  
- Context: 1,000,000 tokens (native 262K, extensible to 1M) / 131,072 output  
- #1 benchmark: PaperBench 93.0%; GPQA Diamond 92.6%[8]

**Qwen3.8 2.4T A95B**  
- Context: 262,144 native, extensible to 1,010,000 tokens / 131,072 output  
- #1 benchmark: PaperBench 93.0%; GPQA Diamond 92.6%[9]

**Muse Spark 1.2 (xhigh)**  
- Context: 1,048,576 tokens  
- #1 benchmark: None reported as global #1 (ModelCap Index rank #4 at 81.0)[10]

**Gemini 3.7 Flash (high)**  
- Context: 1,048,576 input / 65,536 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: WebDev Arena 1,588 Elo (#1); GDM-MRCR v2 97.0% recall at 128K depth[11][12]

**DeepSeek V4 Pro 0813 (max)**  
- Context: 1,048,576 input / 384,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: SWE-bench Verified 96.40% (#1 open-weight, #2 overall); MRCR 1M 83.5% (vs Flash 78.7%)[13][14]

**Qwen3.8 27B (xhigh)**  
- Context: 262,144 native, extensible to 1,000,000 tokens / 131,072 output  
- #1 benchmark: None reported as global #1 (GPQA Diamond 89.2%, behind 92.6%)[15]

**Motif 3**  
- Context: 262,144 tokens (256K native)  
- #1 benchmark: Highest AA Intelligence Index (47) among Korea's four foundation-model developers[16]

**MiniMax-M3**  
- Context: 1,048,576 tokens (512K guaranteed minimum) / ~262,144–512K output  
- #1 benchmark: SWE-Bench Pro 59.0% (edges GPT-5.5 58.6%)[17]

**DeepSeek V4 Pro (max)**  
- Context: 1,048,576 input / 384,000 output tokens  
- #1 benchmark: SWE-bench Verified 96.40% (#1 open-weight)[18][13]

**MiMo-V2.5-Pro**  
- Context: 1,050,000 tokens  
- #1 benchmark: Claimed top rankings on ClawEval, GDPVal, SWE-bench Pro (independent verification pending)[19]

**Inkling**  
- Context: 1,000,000 tokens  
- #1 benchmark: AIME 2026 97.1%; VoiceBench 91.4%  (vendor-reported, independent testing pending)[20]

**Hy3**  
- Context: 262,144 tokens (256K)  
- #1 benchmark: CL-bench / CL-bench Life in-context learning (outperforms GLM-5.1)[21][22]

**Ling 3.0 Flash**  
- Context: 262,144 tokens (256K native, extendable to 1M) / 32,768–65,536 output  
- #1 benchmark: None reported as global #1 (AIME 2026 93.2%, GPQA 85.5% 89th pct)[23][24]
